what: You read a text and choose the one correct answer to a question.
tests: Reading: main idea, details, inference and the writer's purpose.

scoring.note: Pearson says it is scored as either correct or incorrect.

strategy: Read the question first, then the text.
Remove options that are not supported by the text.
Be careful with options that use words from the text but change the meaning.
example_prompt: What is the main purpose of the text? (to compare / to warn / to describe a process / to advertise)

strong.answer: Picks the option that matches the whole text.
strong.why: Main purpose is about the whole text, not one sentence.

medium.answer: Picks an option that matches only the first paragraph.
medium.why: Partly true but not the main purpose.

weak.answer: Picks the option that repeats the most words from the text.
weak.why: Same words do not mean same meaning.

mistakes: Choosing by matching words, not meaning.
Using your own knowledge instead of the text.
